description: A script for generating and emailing a report of MISP (Malware Information Sharing Platform) statistics, including gathering data from MISP, building a report, and optionally sending it via email. It is designed to be run periodically via cron.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes and returns a PyMISP instance with provided URL, key, and verification setting.

methods.name: get_data
methods.description: Fetches MISP event data within a specified timeframe or date range, processes it to generate statistics and detailed event info.

methods.name: build_report
methods.description: Constructs a textual report and attachments from the gathered statistics, with options for sanitization.

methods.name: add_report_body
methods.description: Adds a section to the report body with a subtitle and sorted data, returning updated report text and CSV attachment content.

methods.name: msg_attach
methods.description: Creates an email MIME attachment from content with a filename.

methods.name: print_report
methods.description: Outputs the report via email or console, sending email if configured.

methods.name: get_sanitized_report
methods.description: Filters or consolidates tags in datasets to sanitize or bundle them for reporting.
